posts.title: Leaders Without Borders Summit Held in the UK
posts.author: Credence Holdings
posts.excerpt: Credence Holdings and CEO Adeline Quarshie were honoured at the Leaders Without Borders Summit in London — winning Innovative Company of the Year for the Credence Dream Home product and the Hall of Fame Woman of the Year award.
body: Dated 17th to 19th May, 2023, and hosted at the Millennium Gloucester Hotel, Kensington, London, U.K, was the Leaders Without Borders Summit with the theme “Global Partnerships and Sustainable Investments” — with the sole aim of offering lively conversations and generating rich networking opportunities while providing learning opportunities in leadership, entrepreneurship, and respect for culture.

The LWB Annual Business Summit is not just a summit but a global initiative created to encourage a strong strategic economic and geopolitical partnership by promoting trade and investment. The LWB’s drive is global investment opportunities and development for stakeholders across borders.

Once again, Credence Holdings’ quest to provide tailored solutions to its cherished customers had already inspired us to birth and niche the “Credence Dream Home” and the “Credence Loan Abroad” products respectively. A product that has been designed for Ghanaians in the diaspora won Credence Holdings the prestigious award in the category of “Innovative Company of the Year” for the product Credence Dream Home for the diasporan community, and the Chief Executive Officer, Adeline Quarshie (Ms.), won for herself the Hall of Fame Woman of the Year Award at the Leaders Without Borders.

This leap cannot be emphasized enough given the fact that the Credence Dream Home and Loan Abroad is just one year after its introduction, yet could brew such impact with such intensity and be recognized by a prestigious international award body such as Leaders Without Borders Global.

This milestone establishes the drive of Credence Holdings’ bid to provide nothing but the best of products to serve its clientele. Credence observed with great care and concern the struggles of especially Ghanaians in the diaspora in their quest to build or acquire properties back home, and also non-Ghanaians who wish to create multiple streams of income for themselves. The financing ecosystem in Ghana has continued to develop over the past ten years, making it much more feasible for people to buy and access property.

That notwithstanding, though there are mortgage options available to anyone who wants to build or purchase properties in Ghana, the credit credentials as required have deterred many, especially those in the diaspora, from accessing them. Either the bureaucratic processes are too many, or one does not meet up with the creditworthiness scale of the said institution. Now, this is where Credence Holdings comes in to give better options with its brand-new product, “Credence Dream Home Loan.”

Quite beyond that, the recent expansion in the real estate industry is a sumptuous opportunity for anyone with the sole purpose of owning a property and creating multiple streams of income to jump into. The rental market in Accra, for example, is vast. Statistics show that 37.5% of all households in Accra are renting — that is roughly 22% of the population of Ghana.

Unfortunately, regardless of the fact that there are many opportunities lying in wait in the real estate industry, macro-economic conditions such as the depreciation of the cedi to the main trading currency, the dollar, and other factors such as the inflation rate and the policy rate, have made these opportunities almost inaccessible.

To mention but a few, the recent decline in trust in both family and friends alike has made it almost impossible for anyone in the diaspora to undertake a project back home, leaving it in the care of such ones in their absence. Some people have ended up being swindled, duped, or even scammed.

The challenge of acquiring litigation-free land, and even getting the land in a preferred area vis-à-vis its related cost, sometimes discourages many who want to undertake such projects back home. Others who tend to fall on building agents and even companies end up being charged sometimes double or thrice the amount the project would have cost.

What is the Credence Dream Home product? It is a carefully tailored product designed for both Ghanaians and non-Ghanaians in the diaspora who wish to build in comfort and also invest in the real estate industry in Ghana. Being aware of the challenges that mire the opportunities in real estate, Credence developed a staged model that would give especially those in the diaspora the easiness of building.
The stages are:
Other benefits that await are:

body.h: Providing Financial Support for the Project

body: Even though there seem to be mortgage plans, the conditions of some people in the diaspora are such that the mortgage plans do not feature their considerations, hence casting them out of access. However, the Credence Dream Home product affords you the grace to plan your finances and build at your own financial pace based on the structural stages demarcated in the project’s strategic strata levels.

body.h: Supervising Your Building Project Whilst You Focus on Your Daily Business

body: Credence Real Estate understands the dynamics of family and family goals in an ever-changing culture such as ours. People are becoming more and more nuclear in their family orientation, hence not wishing to allow extended family to come into the knowledge of important projects such as building, thereby necessitating the need to quietly and privately undertake these projects. Credence Real Estate is willing to do such supervision for you.
Beyond building for you, we are also master stewards in the business of managing assets — by renting, selling, or creating a market-attractive value for the property.

In all, it should be said the two-day summit was characterized by applause, appreciation, and jaw-dropping moments when Ms. Quarshie, the Chief Executive Officer, was given a fifteen-minute slot to speak to the audience on the products.

Everyone thinks Credence Dream Home and Loan Abroad is a carefully tailored product that would save many hearts from breaking and many pockets from being duped and scammed — and we at Credence think so too.

Taking the opportunity of the moment, Ms. Quarshie expressed her sincerest appreciation to the leadership of the Leaders Without Borders for the keen recognition of the product. She also thanked the entire customer base of Credence Holdings, the staff, management, media partners, and all and sundry. This award is dedicated to you all.
Credence Holdings. Still, we are credible…
Credibility in World Class Service.

posts.title: Credence Real Estate and Asset Management (USA–Ghana) Launches Global Opportunities to Own a Home in Ghana
posts.author: Credence Holdings
posts.excerpt: Through its US and Ghana arms, Credence Real Estate and Asset Management launches a global pathway for Ghanaians at home and in the diaspora to own a home — addressing Ghana’s housing deficit, land risks and financing gaps.
body: The Credence brand has penetrated the real estate industry with global opportunities and well-researched, developed strategies to own a home — through its parent company Credence Holdings, USA, and Credence Real Estate and Asset Management, Ghana.

While properties in Accra are increasing in value and price, investing in real estate in Ghana is relatively more affordable than in more developed countries around the globe. For example, according to realtor.com, a credible rent site in America, it is estimated that the average American family pays about $1,827.00 per month for a one- or two-bedroom apartment. That is an equivalent of GH₵15,529.50 at the rate of 8.5 cedis to a dollar — an amount that could cater for about a year or two of advance payment for a two-bedroom apartment in some areas in Accra.

That notwithstanding, Ghana still has a large deficit in the housing industry and, consequently, a high demand for housing. Experts suggest that Ghana’s housing deficit stands at around 2 million. From an investor’s or individual’s point of view, this deficit creates opportunities to invest in housing in Ghana, especially in the cosmopolitan and metropolitan cities — namely Accra, Kumasi and Takoradi.

The rental market in Accra, for example, is vast. Statistics show that 37.5% of all households in Accra are renting — that is roughly 22% of the population of Ghana. Building a house in Ghana, as an individual or investor, could open up a new revenue stream for you from renting it out in the low, mid, or high-end market, as well as help you save money.

The opportunities in the real estate industry are quite mouth-watering, yet the challenges that face individuals are staggering. For example, getting a plot of land comes with some unassumed challenges and struggles that can only be noticed when one is deeply involved. Challenges such as litigation, threats on life, and the risk of being duped are but a few of them.

The current economic downturn of Ghana — with an inflation rate standing at 33.9% as at Aug. 2022, the cedi which had already depreciated in value by about 30.1% as at Jan. 2023 to the dollar on the interbank and forex markets, and the Bank of Ghana raising its monetary policy rate to 27% per annum in November 2022 — presents a few of the macro-economic challenges that stare in the face of any “newbie” who wishes to be a property owner, or any existing property owner who wishes to rent out or sell a property.

These challenges used to be a joy-stopper for persons interested in owning properties and making a business out of it — but not until Credence Real Estate and Asset Management, a subsidiary of Credence Holdings, came on the scene. With exceptional service and credibility, Credence has continuously impacted households and individuals and caused people to acquire properties with ease. The management of Credence Real Estate and Asset Management believes that everyone should be able to acquire properties with the assistance it has carved out for its customers.

Ms. Adeline Quarshie, at a launch of Credence Real Estate and Asset Management in the USA on Saturday, January 7, 2023, stated that “the company will help you build, offering you loans and flexibility in credibility. We have put together the simplest engineered method in research around the globe to help you own your house and home. No matter where you are in the world, count on Credence.”

Home is where our story begins. It is where dreams are birthed, destinies nurtured, lives modelled, and values cultivated. In as much as it feels good to leave home, it even feels better to come back. Home is where love resides and memories are created — a place to offer help to strangers, entertain friends, and have unending laughter. A house is made of bricks, blocks and beams, but a home is made of love and endless hope. Just like the words of Barack Obama in his book, The Audacity of Hope, this is only possible within the endless walls of a home.

Credence Real Estate and Asset Management, a distinct global entity, has developed an all-inclusive system that affords each and every individual and entity the laxity of owning a property — helping you sell a property, rent out a property, rent a property for you, manage a property, or convert your house into a home.
Whether in Ghana or in the diaspora, we have a solidified financial arrangement that will afford you the ability to build or acquire your own property with less or no stress.

It was not a cliché when Credence Real Estate and Asset Management was nicknamed the “Messiah” of real estate and asset management. Offering you services with truth, integrity, value, professionalism, and most importantly a God-fearing consciousness, you are sure to experience nothing but the best of services — leading you into becoming a property owner or renting a property in the spirit of utmost peace.

It is a known truth that “the ache for home lives in all of us — the safe place where we can go as we are and not be questioned.” To underestimate your home is to underestimate your humanity and the gravity of destiny fulfilment.
“Everywhere is nowhere” — but indeed, there is no place like home. You too can own a house that can become your home; it is just a handshake away with Credence Real Estate and Asset Management.
Credence Real Estate and Asset Management — you too can own a home because, still, we are credible!!
